summary.text: James Arena-DeRosa is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 8th Middlesex District since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career includes leading the nonprofit Foodshare and serving as New England director of the Peace Corps and as a regional administrator at the U.S. Department of Agriculture.

paragraphs.text: Arena-DeRosa graduated from Xaverian Brothers High School.

According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes work as a freelance community advocate, president and CEO of Foodshare, director of public advocacy at Oxfam America, New England director of the Peace Corps under the Clinton administration, northeast regional administrator for the U.S. Department of Agriculture Food and Nutrition Service under the Obama administration, and special assistant to the Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth.
Arena-DeRosa took office in 2023, succeeding Carolyn Dykema, and won the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Joint Committees on Agriculture and Fisheries, Housing, Public Service, and Veterans and Federal Affairs.
